ITEM 1 | Cream-to-beige cubed pieces, about 1.5-2 cm each, with firm edges, matte surface, and some light golden-brown browned patches on a few sides; piled in a loose mound in the upper-middle of a stainless steel mixing bowl (about 20 cm across) | 95
ITEM 2 | Small dark reddish-brown, glossy, wrinkled-skinned whole pieces, roughly 1-1.5 cm, scattered among and beneath the cubes at the bowl's lower-center; slightly soft-looking and moist | 25
